title: Decoding Demographic un-fairness from Indian Names

bias_targets.methodology: Predicting gender from full Indian names using transformer models and applying them to longitudinal educational records and social media data to quantify disparities in representation, academic percentiles, and online engagement between men and women over time.

Predicting broad caste categories (General vs. Reserved/Backward classes) from full Indian names using trained classifiers, and analyzing large-scale datasets from competitive exams and social networks to measure historical inequalities in participation, performance, and platform representation.
